ImperialCourtColorHandoff.Purpose: Portable color-system data and instructions for another AI working on imperial court game costumes. Do not infer the game title from filenames.

ApprovalBoundaries.Rule: User-approved rules and generated palette proposals are distinct.
The user permits royal gold and Chu Sa red across ranks 6, 7 and 8, with progressively greater presence.
Medium-tier HEX values reproduce the source atlas. Light and deep tiers are generated proposals, not individually approved colors.
No personal favorite color has been assigned to any character. Personality does not restrict everyone in a group to a single hue.
Exact royal-color coverage percentages and the exact Chu Sa red HEX remain unapproved.
This file does not replace the Costume Design Bible, approve costume images, or grant phoenix-motif permission at every rank.

DesignRules.Rule: Sexy or sensual styling is a shared game aesthetic, not a synonym for Alluring or Proud. Gentle and Dignified costumes may also be open-necked or off-shoulder.

Assess personality through the complete garment design: neckline construction, overlaps, shoulders, sleeves, waist, skirt, fabric behavior and embroidery. Do not classify by exposure, face, hair or pose.
Gentle and Dignified are separate directions. Do not automatically impose Dignified identity on Gentle designs.
Preserve both original eight-rank collections. Structured and soft foundations may serve different groups; the original structured collection's new personality assignment is pending.

Use each character's source palette for the selected season. Hue families may change between seasons. Neckline, mantle and layering may vary with season while personality and rank remain recognizable.
Ranks 1–3 use a light depth tier, ranks 4–6 a medium tier, ranks 7–8 a deep tier. Rank-depth is separate from royal-color placement.
Gentle or soft clothing must not be simplified into a lower-rank costume. Use the matching original rank as the luxury benchmark.
Select historical/fantasy balance separately by group. No universal 85/15 ratio applies.
HEX values are midtone palette anchors, not instructions to fill each entire garment with one flat color.
Permit coherent lighter and deeper tones within each main and secondary color family for designed fabric layers. Main and secondary roles need not belong to different hue families.
Render folds, shadows, silk sheen and highlights naturally. Keep lighting variations distinct from intentionally different fabric tones.
AI may render lighting automatically, but designed tone placement should be described in the prompt. Exact HEX reproduction in generated images is not guaranteed.
Gauze HEX values specify solid reference colors. Transparency is a separate material property, not an instruction to replace its hue with white.
Generate or edit images only when requested; a request for analysis or a prompt does not authorize generation.

ImperialCourtColorHandoff.ReusablePromptInstruction: Treat the supplied HEX colors as midtone palette anchors, not uniform flat fills. Preserve the overall color family while using coherent lighter and deeper tones across garment layers. Render natural shadows and silk highlights freely. Keep the main, secondary and accent hierarchy clear without dividing the costume into rigid color blocks. Apply royal gold or Chu Sa red according to the selected rank and placement rule. Do not use exposed skin to classify personality.

RoyalColorSystem.RankRule: More substantial accents than rank 6; less than rank 8
RoyalColorSystem.PlacementNote: Gold and red are available within the three-rank hierarchy. Do not impose gold-only or red-only by personality. A dominant royal main garment for the Empress is an implementation proposal; exact placement and proportions require approval.
RoyalColorSystem.LowerRanks: No new royal-color permission is granted to ranks 1–5 by this handoff. Do not confuse ordinary yellow/red families in individual palettes with the designated royal-color layer.

DepthTiers.Method: Medium preserves source HEX exactly. Light/deep variants adjust OKLCH lightness and chroma without intentionally rotating hue; gamut compression reduces chroma. Main-color lightness was checked to descend from tier 1 to tier 3.
DepthTiers.PersonalityTreatment: Gentle: softly saturated depth. Cold and Dignified: muted depth. Alluring, Sharp and Proud: stronger saturation may be retained. These are palette-generation choices, not final character assignments.
DepthTiers.ReviewLimit: No claim is made that all character pairs are perceptually unique. No extra fixed highlight/shadow HEX triplets are required for every garment color.
